name: Babushkas

features.name: Symbol upgrades
features.description: Four features that pop dolls into better symbols.

review:
Russian dolls that pop open into smaller, more valuable versions, on 17 lines. Four symbol-upgrade features keep the chain reaction going, mystery bears add surprises, and the bonus gives free spins with assured wilds.

Low volatility and a 390x cap make it about as gentle as slots get, with a 95.8% RTP. Charming to watch, but don't expect big wins.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
